title: Refund window disclosed when the request falls outside it
question: When the customer asks for a refund on an order older than the 30-day refund window, does the assistant clearly tell them the window and that this order falls outside it?
passDescription: The reply states the 30-day refund window and that this order is outside it, or correctly identifies the order as inside the window.
failDescription: The reply processes, promises, or implies a refund on an out-of-window order, or never mentions the window when the order is outside it.
notes: Synthetic support-assistant criterion. Mock cues exist only so the lexical mock can exercise the harness; a real provider ignores them.
